topic: Cycling of Materials in the Ecosystem
key_concepts: Essential elements cycle between biotic and abiotic components of ecosystems
The water cycle is the continuous movement of water through the atmosphere, land, and bodi
Solar energy drives evaporation and transpiration
Evaporation changes liquid water into water vapor
Transpiration releases excess water vapor from plant stomata
Condensation forms clouds as water vapor cools into liquid droplets
Precipitation returns atmospheric water to Earth as rain, snow, hail, fog, or sleet
Infiltration seeps water into soil to form groundwater in aquifers
Surface runoff moves water across land into lakes, rivers, or oceans
The oxygen-carbon dioxide cycle links photosynthesis and respiration
Photosynthesis uses carbon dioxide and water to make sugar and releases oxygen
Respiration takes in oxygen and releases carbon dioxide
